title: Raccoon wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx="26" cy="22" r="12" fill="#8a8f9e"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="22" r="12" fill="#8a8f9e"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="22" r="6" fill="#d98fa8"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="22" r="6" fill="#d98fa8"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="34" ry="30" fill="#a8adba"/>
  <!-- cheek fur tufts -->
  <polygon points="12,46 4,52 14,58" fill="#a8adba"/>
  <polygon points="88,46 96,52 86,58" fill="#a8adba"/>
  <!-- mask band -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="46" rx="30" ry="12" fill="#5b6172"/>
  <!-- sunglasses -->
  <rect x="21" y="39" width="25" height="15" rx="5" fill="#2b2f3d"/>
  <rect x="54" y="39" width="25" height="15" rx="5" fill="#2b2f3d"/>
  <rect x="45" y="44" width="10" height="4" fill="#2b2f3d"/>
  <rect x="24" y="42" width="7" height="5" rx="2" fill="#9fe8ff"/>
  <rect x="57" y="42" width="7" height="5" rx="2" fill="#9fe8ff"/>
  <rect x="19" y="40" width="3" height="13" rx="1" fill="#3d4353"/>
  <rect x="78" y="40" width="3" height="13" rx="1" fill="#3d4353"/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="16" ry="12" fill="#e8e4dc"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="60" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#3a2f3f"/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d="M50 64 Q50 70 44 71" stroke="#7a6f78" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M50 64 Q50 70 56 71" stroke="#7a6f78" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- whisker dots -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="67" r="1.3" fill="#8a8f9e"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="67" r="1.3" fill="#8a8f9e"/>
</svg>
